subject: Rush: 60 bundles of 12x10x6 by Friday
body: Hi team, our holiday kits sold out faster than we planned.
Can we get 60 bundles of the 12x10x6 boxes delivered by Friday?
And could you waive the rush fee this once?

truth.handling: Place the rush order for 60 bundles at the $21.40 contract price, 40 from North and 20 from Valley, which fits the open credit. The $95 rush fee waiver is over the $75 cap, so it waits for you.
